description: Creates two fresh private keys (WIF): one for the Flux ID that will own apps, one for the address that pays. The response contains the secrets; store them in the MCP server environment as FLUX_ID_PRIVATE_KEY and FLUX_PAYMENT_PRIVATE_KEY, then restart the server. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere by this tool.

fluxIdPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux ID that owns the app. Use a dedicated key from flux_generate_keys, never a main wallet key.

paymentPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux address that pays. Fund it with only what you intend to spend.

name: flux_generate_keys
title: Generate a new Flux ID and payment key pair
